logger.doc:name: Business Validation Logger
logger.message: #["Business validation failed - " ++ error.description ++ ", Trace ID: " ++ (vars.traceId default correlationId) ++ ", Order ID: " ++ (vars.orderId default "N/A")]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: { code: "BUSINESS_VALIDATION_FAILED", message: "Order business validation failed", details: error.description, timestamp: now(), traceId: vars.traceId default correlationId, path: attributes.requestPath default "", method: attributes.method default "", statusCode: 422, context: { service: "order-process-api", operation: flow.name, orderId: vars.orderId default null, correlationId: correlationId, validationStep: error.additionalInfo.step default "unknown" }, retryable: false, helpUrl: "https://docs.api.company.com/errors/business-validation" } }

logger.doc:name: Order Processing Error Logger
logger.message: #["Order processing transaction failed - " ++ error.description ++ ", Trace ID: " ++ (vars.traceId default correlationId) ++ ", Order ID: " ++ (vars.orderId default "N/A")]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: { code: "ORDER_PROCESSING_FAILED", message: "Order processing transaction failed", details: error.description, timestamp: now(), traceId: vars.traceId default correlationId, path: attributes.requestPath default "", method: attributes.method default "", statusCode: 500, context: { service: "order-process-api", operation: flow.name, orderId: vars.orderId default null, correlationId: correlationId, failurePoint: error.additionalInfo.failurePoint default "unknown", compensationStatus: error.additionalInfo.compensationStatus default "not_executed" }, retryable: true, retryAfter: 60, helpUrl: "https://docs.api.company.com/errors/order-processing" } }

logger.doc:name: System API Connectivity Logger
logger.message: #["System API connectivity error - " ++ error.description ++ ", Trace ID: " ++ (vars.traceId default correlationId)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: { code: "SYSTEM_API_UNAVAILABLE", message: "System API connectivity error", details: "Unable to connect to downstream system API", timestamp: now(), traceId: vars.traceId default correlationId, path: attributes.requestPath default "", method: attributes.method default "", statusCode: 502, context: { service: "order-process-api", operation: flow.name, upstreamError: error.description, correlationId: correlationId }, retryable: true, retryAfter: 15, helpUrl: "https://docs.api.company.com/errors/system-connectivity" } }

logger.doc:name: System API Timeout Logger
logger.message: #["System API timeout error - " ++ error.description ++ ", Trace ID: " ++ (vars.traceId default correlationId)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: { code: "SYSTEM_API_TIMEOUT", message: "System API timeout", details: "Timeout while waiting for system API response", timestamp: now(), traceId: vars.traceId default correlationId, path: attributes.requestPath default "", method: attributes.method default "", statusCode: 504, context: { service: "order-process-api", operation: flow.name, timeoutDuration: "30s", correlationId: correlationId }, retryable: true, retryAfter: 30, helpUrl: "https://docs.api.company.com/errors/system-timeout" } }

logger.doc:name: Process Validation Logger
logger.message: #["Process API validation error - " ++ error.description ++ ", Trace ID: " ++ (vars.traceId default correlationId)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: { code: "PROCESS_VALIDATION_ERROR", message: "Process request validation failed", details: error.description, timestamp: now(), traceId: vars.traceId default correlationId, path: attributes.requestPath default "", method: attributes.method default "", statusCode: 400, validationErrors: [{ field: "process_request", message: error.description, code: "INVALID_PROCESS_REQUEST" }], context: { service: "order-process-api", operation: flow.name, correlationId: correlationId }, retryable: false, helpUrl: "https://docs.api.company.com/errors/process-validation" } }

logger.doc:name: Process Resource Not Found Logger
logger.message: #["Process API resource not found - Path: " ++ (attributes.requestPath default "UNKNOWN") ++ ", Trace ID: " ++ (vars.traceId default correlationId)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: { code: "PROCESS_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND", message: "Process resource not found", details: "The requested order or process resource does not exist", timestamp: now(), traceId: vars.traceId default correlationId, path: attributes.requestPath default "", method: attributes.method default "", statusCode: 404, context: { service: "order-process-api", operation: flow.name, requestedResource: vars.orderId default "unknown", correlationId: correlationId }, retryable: false, helpUrl: "https://docs.api.company.com/errors/process-not-found" } }

logger.doc:name: Compensation Error Logger
logger.message: #["Compensation process failed - " ++ error.description ++ ", Trace ID: " ++ (vars.traceId default correlationId) ++ ", Order ID: " ++ (vars.orderId default "N/A")]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: { code: "COMPENSATION_FAILED", message: "Order processing failed and compensation incomplete", details: error.description, timestamp: now(), traceId: vars.traceId default correlationId, path: attributes.requestPath default "", method: attributes.method default "", statusCode: 500, context: { service: "order-process-api", operation: flow.name, orderId: vars.orderId default null, correlationId: correlationId, compensationStep: error.additionalInfo.step default "unknown", manualIntervention: true }, retryable: false, helpUrl: "https://docs.api.company.com/errors/compensation-failed" } }

logger.doc:name: Process System Error Logger
logger.message: #["Process API system error - " ++ error.description ++ ", Detail: " ++ (error.detailedDescription default "N/A") ++ ", Trace ID: " ++ (vars.traceId default correlationId)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: { code: "PROCESS_INTERNAL_ERROR", message: "Internal process error occurred", details: "An unexpected error occurred in the order processing service", timestamp: now(), traceId: vars.traceId default correlationId, path: attributes.requestPath default "", method: attributes.method default "", statusCode: 500, context: { service: "order-process-api", operation: flow.name, correlationId: correlationId, errorType: error.errorType.identifier default "UNKNOWN" }, retryable: true, retryAfter: 30, helpUrl: "https://docs.api.company.com/errors/process-internal" } }

sub-flow.name: extract-process-error-context-subflow
sub-flow.set-variable: #[{ "timestamp": now(), "service": "order-process-api", "operation": flow.name, "correlationId": correlationId, "traceId": vars.traceId default correlationId, "orderId": vars.orderId default null, "customerId": vars.customerId default null, "processingStage": vars.processingStage default "initialization" }]

logger.doc:name: Business Error Logger
logger.message: #["Business Error - Code: " ++ (payload.error.code default "UNKNOWN") ++ ", Message: " ++ (payload.error.message default "Unknown error") ++ ", Trace ID: " ++ vars.traceId ++ ", Order ID: " ++ (vars.orderId default "N/A")]
